name: obsidian-chronicle
description: Integrated Obsidian vault + Claude Code chronicle plugin with two pillars. (1) The obsidian-vault agent — the single, unified handler for ALL Obsidian vault work: adding, updating, deleting, organizing, searching, and analyzing notes, tasks, properties, canvases, and bases with correct wikilink/frontmatter/daily-note semantics (the main session delegates vault work to it instead of using generic file tools). (2) Automatic session recording — auto-generates Obsidian-format session summaries and Daily Note entries from Claude Code sessions (task accomplishments, research findings, decisions), with mid-session checkpoints via /done and the SessionEnd/PreCompact hooks. Configure with /obsidian-chronicle:setup.
